welcome-message.name: Welcome Message
welcome-message.description: Sent to a user immediately after they register.
welcome-message.default_content:
Hello {{user_name}},

Welcome to {{app_name}}! We are thrilled to have you.

You can login here: Login

password-reset-otp.name: Password Reset OTP
password-reset-otp.description: Sent when a user requests to reset their password.
password-reset-otp.default_content:
Hello {{user_name}},

Your OTP code to reset your password is: {{otp_code}}

If you did not request this, please ignore this email.

password-reset-success.name: Password Reset Success
password-reset-success.description: Sent when a user successfully resets their password.
password-reset-success.default_content:
Hello {{user_name}},

Your password has been successfully reset. If you did not make this change, please contact support immediately.

registration-otp.name: Registration OTP
registration-otp.description: Sent when a user starts registration to verify their email.
registration-otp.default_content:
Hello {{user_name}},

Your OTP code to verify your email for registration is: {{otp_code}}

If you did not request this, please ignore this email.

team-member-created.name: Team Member Created
team-member-created.description: Sent to a new team member with their login credentials.
team-member-created.default_subject: You have been added to a team on {{app_name}}
team-member-created.default_content:
Hello {{user_name}},

You have been added as a team member on {{app_name}}.

Your login credentials are:

Email: {{login_email}}

Password: {{login_password}}

You can login here: Login

Please change your password after logging in.

violence-warning.name: Policy Breach Warning
violence-warning.description: Sent to a contact when they are flagged for using inappropriate language.
violence-warning.default_content:
Hello {{contact.first_name}},

This is an automated notice regarding a recent interaction.

We detected the use of inappropriate language that breaches our communication policies.

Breach Words: {{breach.words}}

Context: "{{breach.transcript}}"

Please ensure all future communications adhere to our guidelines, as repeated violations may result in a permanent block.
